suit_meaning: Diamond — active development, working content en route to a destination repo (custos suit taxonomy, reused here)
event: Gravity Core system (redundancy_entity/) copied from hodie to eaprime1/gravitar

transition.method: Copy, not move -- source retained in full, matching the system's own conservation-bias principle. 18 of 19 files copied (code + design docs + small manifests); beasis_catalog.json (25MB scan-result data, Dec 2025, tied to the Pixel 8a's local corpus) stayed in hodie -- data, not code.

open_questions: Whether/how to reconcile this system's keep-every-duplicate philosophy with duplicatus's opposite (keep-one-copy) approach -- see gravitar's README Open Questions section
Whether the project gets revived (Phases 2-5 were designed, never built) or stays dormant
Whether the underlying 3GB/42K-file corpus (device-local on the Pixel 8a) ever moves somewhere version-controlled
notes: Found during a hodie<->custos comparison pass this session; gravitar was already correctly named for this but had never received content. Not a revival of the project, just giving it one clear address instead of living inside a different repo's subfolder.
